method: Each listed rendered page was viewed directly with view_image. Visual review, not a mathematical proof audit.

pages.observations: Title, author roles, both abstracts and page number fit; Chinese and mathematical fonts render.
Contents leaders, heading levels and right-aligned page numbers are legible.
Contents mathematical intervals and subsections render without overlap.
Contents appendices and page numbers fit; unused lower page space is intentional.
Main theorem and short-interval definitions fit within margins.
Coverage table and introduction fit; first integer bound wraps within its own cell.
Input summary and zero-count notation are clear; visible :: separates Lean file and declarations.
Twelve CS coefficient rows and density inequality render clearly.
Rosser and integrated explicit formulas fit with numbered multiline displays.
Finite-height RH and shared-height CHJII formula render without clipping.
Twelve CHL rows and source-status paragraphs fit.
Zero-count definitions and theta-kernel cases fit, including the lower display.
Real-axis proof, complex-power estimate and prime-power bound are legible.
Strict-endpoint extraction and chapter 4 opening fit; long Lean identifier wraps within margins.
